contrast: Drug_Resistance n=49 versus Drug_Sensitive n=81 tuberculosis
endpoint: Aitchison community composition; PERMANOVA R2 with paired PERMDISP
analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per unique subject
covariates_or_strata: Primary resistance-status-only model; sensitivity includes nominal 50/75-nt read-length category using marginal terms or stratification
justification: Run labels map deterministically to Supplementary Table S3 and reflect phenotypic or molecular drug-susceptibility evidence independent of microbiome output
main_limitations: Drug-resistance category may be clinically heterogeneous; treatment history, age, sex, antibiotics, severity and comorbidities unavailable; exact library batch unavailable

analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per unique subject
justification: Complements the primary community-level estimand with interpretable ecological summaries
main_limitations: Depth and classifier-yield sensitivity; direct-species subcomposition is not absolute burden

analysis_unit: One valid native report per subject
justification: Technical classifier-yield endpoint can reveal group-correlated detection behavior
main_limitations: Not bacterial burden; upstream host depletion and exact host tool/reference unresolved

contrast: Resistance-status effect consistency within nominal 50-nt and 75-nt strata
analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per subject
covariates_or_strata: Stratify by frozen nominal read-length category; report interaction only as exploratory
justification: Both resistance groups occur in both nominal length strata, allowing a technical robustness check
main_limitations: Nominal/average pre-host-filter length does not fully describe deposited variable-length reads; subgroup precision is reduced

analysis_unit: One valid native report per subject
covariates_or_strata: At least 10% within-external prevalence; 5% and 20% sensitivity; multiplicity control
justification: Provides a bounded detection-based taxonomic description
main_limitations: Large feature space, depth dependence and no same-contrast replication cohort

covariates_or_strata: Cohort-specific ANCOM-BC2; ALDEx2 sensitivity; false-discovery control
justification: May localize community-level association while preserving compositional inference
main_limitations: No public negative-control run, upstream host depletion, sparse taxa and unmeasured clinical confounding

contrast: Drug resistance as a causal microbiome determinant
analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per subject
justification: The independent label makes association estimable, not causal
main_limitations: Treatment, disease duration, prior antibiotics and severity may influence both resistance status and community

contrast: DNA and the excluded RNA modality as independent subjects
